text: Philip Morris International Inc. is a Virginia corporation listed on the New York Stock Exchange (PM); per its 2026 proxy statement its largest disclosed shareholders are The Vanguard Group (8.57%), Capital World Investors (8.17%), Capital International Investors (6.61%) and BlackRock, Inc. (6.22%); no state or sovereign-fund holder is listed among them.
short: PMI is NYSE-listed; largest disclosed holders are index/asset managers - no state holder.

source.name: Philip Morris International Inc., 2026 Proxy Statement (DEF 14A, SEC EDGAR)
source.quote: The following table sets forth information regarding persons or groups known to the Company to be beneficial owners of more than 5% of the outstanding common stock as of March 13, 2026
